Players Committee card image of [[Lor San Tekka (ALT) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “If you just deployed BB-8 or a Resistance leader to same or related location, may draw top card of Reserve Deck. During your control phase, one of your other Resistance characters present may make a regular move.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/lorsantekka_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e083be48ab147a9c9a69d055ec2467a29b3f0225 e083be4] (24 January 2025). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
